acceptance_predicates.description: The development launcher supplies only explicitly validated tool identities and bounded locale/runtime variables; it never inherits the caller environment or PATH wholesale.
Cargo and Rustc remain bound to the same validated rustup toolchain objects across pathname replacement, and every other tool is resolved through the existing development trust policy.
A verified development bundle passes install, status, bare launch, dynamic-catalog, and provider-free selected/all launch through the real installed ASB boundary.
Missing, replaced, symlinked, or unusable tools produce typed credential-free human and JSON failures without fallback or leaked host paths.
Stable and production launch semantics, authentication, signature, key-management, and trust gates remain unchanged.

definition_of_done: The signed and DCO-certified implementation is independently reviewed and merged through local merge integrity.
Focused hostile-tool and full ASB tests pass at the exact reviewed head.
Required hosted and exact-main post-merge checks are green, and the downstream ASB-TUI installed qualification is rerun.

inputs.description: Descriptor-bound development Cargo and Rustc selection merged by AR-1726.

outputs.description: A bounded development-only environment for the installed standalone frontend.

gates.description: Hostile PATH and tool replacement tests prove object binding and fail-closed diagnostics.
The real installed ASB-to-TUI development journey reaches the provider-free frontend without preflight failure.
Independent review, signed merge integrity, required PR checks, and post-merge checks pass.
